messages:
nina: Quick follow-up from the postmortem on the KV eviction spike. Need explicit owners, timelines, and concrete test additions (regression entries, curated prompt vectors, load profiles, chaos drill).

rob: I can take remediation triage + regression automation. Plan: add targeted regression cases that hit high-ttl and hot-key ranges. Will open WIP PR with test harness by Mon (2025-05-05).

ana: I can own the prompt vectors and baseline capture. Proposal: 80 vectors (50 sanitized session keys + 30 synthetic hot-skew patterns) with metadata and expected metrics. Will store under tests/promptsets/kv-eviction-2025.json.

michael: I9ll own load profiles and the chaos drill. Two profiles: sustained medium load (200rps for 30m) and aggressive spike (100->900rps over 2m, hold 10m). Chaos drill: replica isolation + graceful restart scenario. Will produce k6 jobs and safe-chaos playbook.

nina: CI integration: we want a canary gate that fails deploys on regression spikes and a nightly reg-suite for early detection. How should we gate?

ci-bot: Suggestion: gate on absolute p99 and p999 latency thresholds plus a relative delta on kv-miss ratio vs baseline. Example: p99 < 130ms, p999 < 280ms, kv-miss delta < 7%.

rob: +1. Also recommend annotating PRs with perf-budget labels so reviewers see potential regressions.

ana: For the promptset, I9ll include per-vector expected latencies and kv-hit expectations. Will add a small harness to run promptset locally and in CI.

michael: Chaos draft (will use safe tooling, not raw iptables):
```
# chaos plan sketch
run_load(profile="spike_rapid", duration=600)
wait(30)
isolate_replica(replica_id="replica-b", duration=30)
verify(metrics=["kv_hit_rate","p99_latency","errors"]) 
abort_if(metrics.p99 > 500ms or errors > 0.5%)
```
Will include explicit abort conditions and a dry-run flag.

nina: Owners/timelines: rob -> reg automation (PR by 2025-05-05), ana -> promptset (PR by 2025-05-07), michael -> load+chaos (playbook + k6 by 2025-05-08). I'll be overall program owner and will post weekly status.

ci-bot: Created TICKET-7432: "KV eviction remediation + tests" assigned to rob,ana,michael due 2025-05-12.

rob: CI cadence question: smoke on each push, full reg-suite nightly, extended soak weekly? Cost conscious suggestions welcome.

nina: Proposed cadence: quick smoke on PR, full reg-suite nightly on infra runners, weekly 3h soak in staging. If nightly fails 2x in a row, automatically create a followup incident and notify #incidents.

ana: Also proposing a small dataset of real-sampled keys (sanitized) to capture realistic access patterns. Will include instructions for privacy review.

michael: Will add dashboard panels for the new metrics (per-key kv-hit, p99/p999 tail by key cohort) and link them in the playbook.

rob: I9ll implement test hooks to produce per-key histograms so we can track regressions by key group.

nina: Recurrence detection: add a pattern tag for incidents that match the KV tail signature so we can automatically surface recurring patterns in our incident index. @michael can you add an item to the ticket backlog?

michael: Added backlog item to TICKET-7433: "incident-signature tagging: kv-tail". Will scope next sprint.

nina: Thanks everyone 44d Please leave short status updates in TICKET-7432 and tag me in PRs. Planning note for execs: single stream owners, concrete timelines, CI gating, and recurrence detection to prevent repeats.

ci-bot: Reminder: next status check-in in 7 days."
